programme_facts.value: Colleges and universities may access applicants' internet services including social media profiles as part of their admissions process.
Students whose social media pages include questionable material may be disqualified from admission processes.
In July 2017, 11 percent of respondents in a survey reported that they had refused to admit an applicant based on social media content.
The survey reported that 30 percent of institutions acknowledged reviewing the personal social media accounts of applicants at least some of the time.
